slayer_armaments.name: Armaments
slayer_armaments.scene: Kratos tightening the Chains of his Blades of Chaos around his forearms to arm himself, sparks from a forge, spears and weapons on a rack behind him.

slayer_brutality.name: Brutality
slayer_brutality.scene: Kratos's scarred fist crushing a glowing red beating heart torn from the Hydra, purple-black blood dripping between his fingers, dark violet background.

slayer_dropkick.name: Dropkick
slayer_dropkick.scene: Kratos flying through the air in a drop kick into an Undead Legionnaire, a yellow starburst at the impact, crimson background, dark silhouettes.

slayer_dual_wield.name: Dual Wield
slayer_dual_wield.scene: Kratos holding both Blades of Chaos crossed in front of him, a mirrored copy of the blades behind them in a ghostly echo, red and orange light.

slayer_infernal_blade.name: Infernal Blade
slayer_infernal_blade.scene: A Blade of Chaos burning with dark hellfire, demonic faces in the flames, crimson and black, embers and ash around.

slayer_reaper.name: Reaper
slayer_reaper.scene: Kratos sweeping a Blade of Olympus in a reaping arc, red souls streaming off the victims and into him, healing glow, dark red.

slayer_searing_blow.name: Searing Blow
slayer_searing_blow.scene: A Blade of Chaos glowing white-hot, striking a shield and sending a searing white-orange burst across it, ember sparks.

strike_ironclad.name: Strike
strike_ironclad.scene: Close, dramatic view of Kratos's arm whipping a single Blade of Chaos in one clean slash: a huge bright orange-white cutting arc across a deep burgundy background, chain trailing off the edge.

defend_ironclad.name: Defend
defend_ironclad.scene: Kratos crouched behind a round bronze-and-wood Greek hoplite shield, three arrows and harpy feathers smacking into its face with white impact sparks, teal water-stained sky behind.

twin_strike.name: Twin Strike
twin_strike.scene: Two Blades of Chaos slashing in an X across the frame, two glowing orange-red cutting arcs crossing, chains snapping taut, dark red background.

true_grit.name: True Grit
true_grit.scene: Close-up of Kratos's scarred ash-white hand clenched hard around a broken golden Minotaur horn, knuckles white, a bright glint of light on the gold, dust and sparks falling.

burning_pact.name: Burning Pact
burning_pact.scene: Kratos's hand and a flame-wreathed armored hand of Ares gripping each other in a pact over a burning altar, gold fire licking up the clasped hands, red tattoo visible on Kratos's arm.

sever_soul.name: Sever Soul
sever_soul.scene: Kratos's Blade of Chaos ripping a glowing blue-green spirit out of an Undead Legionnaire, the soul streaming away in a jagged luminous ribbon, red-and-cyan palette.

second_wind.name: Second Wind
second_wind.scene: Kratos kneeling on one knee to catch his breath with a Blade of Chaos planted point-down in the ground, both hands on the hilt, steam rising from his shoulders, bronze bracers and dark blue dusk behind.

entrench.name: Entrench
entrench.scene: Kratos braced behind a barricade of toppled Greek marble column drums and rubble, a Blade of Chaos resting across the top, a fierce orange sunburst sky over the ruins.

sentinel.name: Sentinel
sentinel.scene: Kratos holding up a battered bronze round shield, a blinding white blast of energy splashing against it, lightning crackle, cool grey-blue storm.

fiend_fire.name: Fiend Fire
fiend_fire.scene: Kratos in the Underworld, arms flung out with Blades of Chaos wreathed in flames, three burning ancient Greek shields spinning in the air around him, dark navy background, orange fire.

limit_break.name: Limit Break
limit_break.scene: Kratos in silhouette flexing both arms in a roaring pose in the Rage of Sparta, blazing gold-orange light rays bursting behind him.

double_tap.name: Double Tap
double_tap.scene: A Blade of Chaos slash and its echo: Kratos in deep-blue shadow, two overlapping afterimage slashes in red and orange across his body, chain looping around.

feed.name: Feed
feed.scene: Kratos standing over a fallen Gorgon, bright red orbs streaming up from its body into his open hand, orange and red palette, dark background.

corruption.name: Corruption
corruption.scene: Extreme close-up of Kratos's face half in shadow, eyes burning violet-magenta, black veins of dark corruption crawling along his red tattoo, teal darkness around.

barricade.name: Barricade
barricade.scene: A towering barricade of stacked Greek hoplite shields, broken spears, swords and column fragments filling the frame, a bronze orb helmet on top, desaturated teal and brown.

metallicize.name: Metallicize
metallicize.scene: Kratos standing front-facing in gleaming gold-trimmed bronze armor, steel plating rising across his torso, brilliant rays of light fanning out behind a deep blue sky.

demon_form.name: Demon Form
demon_form.scene: Kratos in full God of War rage: red body glowing from within, eyes burning yellow, arms spread wide with Blades of Chaos flaring flame, huge dark red wing shapes behind him, black background.

berserk.name: Berserk
berserk.scene: Kratos with arms flung wide in a bellowing roar of rage, red tattoo and muscles tense, red light rays tearing out behind him like a frenzy, dark red background.

juggernaut.name: Juggernaut
juggernaut.scene: Kratos charging forward like a juggernaut through a shattering stone gate, boulders and marble slabs exploding off his shoulders, orange fire glow behind.

feel_no_pain.name: Feel No Pain
feel_no_pain.scene: Kratos standing unflinching with his chest out, arrows and spear tips shattering against his body in golden sparks, bronze straps and bracers, stormy dark brown.

dark_embrace.name: Dark Embrace
dark_embrace.scene: Kratos in black void, pale ghostly clawed hands of the Underworld's damned clutching around his shoulders and arms, purple glow on the claws, only gold of his bracers lit.

combust.name: Combust
combust.scene: Kratos as a black silhouette inside a giant yellow fireball, Blades of Chaos burning on his arms, flames licking in great orange swirls, glowing white core.

evolve.name: Evolve
evolve.scene: A heap of Undead Legionnaire skulls with green Hydra venom oozing from empty eye sockets and glowing slime dripping, dark olive background, sickly glowing eyes.

fire_breathing.name: Fire Breathing
fire_breathing.scene: A roaring Chimera head spewing a river of orange flame across the frame, teeth bared, a dark purple storm sky.

inflame.name: Inflame
inflame.scene: A Blade of Chaos wreathed in roaring flame, blazing yellow and orange fire pouring along the blade and chain, dark blue background with drifting sparks.

carnage.name: Carnage
carnage.scene: A heap of slain Gorgons and satyrs in a gory pile, one huge yellow serpentine eye still open, teal scales, red and yellow bodies, dark red background.

ghostly_armor.name: Ghostly Armor
ghostly_armor.scene: Kratos's silhouette wrapped in glowing translucent blue spectral Spartan armor, ghostly plates floating around him, dark blue-black background.

battle_trance.name: Battle Trance
battle_trance.scene: Two shadowy Spartan fighters floating in a dark circle while a golden chain of the Blades of Chaos swings down with a burning link at its end, hypnotic rings around it.

rupture.name: Rupture
rupture.scene: Kratos with arms raised, Blades of Chaos hanging from his wrists, ember-red energy bursting from fresh wounds on his torso, tattoo glowing red.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.scene: Kratos at the center of a spinning Cyclone of Chaos, Blades of Chaos whipping in huge golden circles around him, blurred bright arcs, dark red background.

bash.name: Bash
bash.scene: Kratos driving the spiked Nemean Cestus gauntlet straight down onto an Undead Legionnaire's helmet, orange shockwave burst radiating from the impact, broken temple floor tiles flying.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.scene: A wide sweeping Blade of Chaos slash raking across three Undead Legionnaire silhouettes at once, a huge gold-white cutting arc, burgundy background.

clothesline.name: Clothesline
clothesline.scene: Kratos's forearm and bronze bracer slamming across an Undead Legionnaire's throat, the helmet flying off, orange-white impact burst, dark skin tones.

pommel_strike.name: Pommel Strike
pommel_strike.scene: Kratos smashing the heavy hilt of a Blade of Athena into a soldier's helmet in a close punch, an orange triangular burst behind the impact, dark red.

shrug_it_off.name: Shrug It Off
shrug_it_off.scene: Kratos in a three-quarter view shrugging off a blow, ash-white shoulder with a worn leather cross-strap and bronze pauldron, sparks flying off him, muted blue-grey background.

anger.name: Anger
anger.scene: Kratos lunging forward in a furious two-handed blade swing, streaks of orange, red and blue lightning motion lines wrapping around him.

flex.name: Flex
flex.scene: Close-up of Kratos's flexed bicep wrapped in a bronze bracer, the red tattoo stretched across the tight muscle, a sheen of light on ash-white skin.

warcry.name: Warcry
warcry.scene: Kratos bellowing a Spartan war cry with one fist raised, shockwave lines radiating from his roaring mouth, dark red background.

havoc.name: Havoc
havoc.scene: Kratos's armored fist smashing through a marble statue in a frenzy, shards flying, a ragged scorched tree line against a crimson sky.

perfected_strike.name: Perfected Strike
perfected_strike.scene: A single perfect Blade of Athena slash, a clean white-gold cutting arc and a spray of crimson droplets across a dark red background.

headbutt.name: Headbutt
headbutt.scene: Kratos's bald head crashing into a Minotaur's forehead in a headbutt, a starburst impact with fiery orange lines radiating.

power_through.name: Power Through
power_through.scene: Kratos charging forward through a hail of arrows, two arrows stuck in his bracer, bronze shoulder armor, one wound glowing red on his chest, deep blue dusk.

flame_barrier.name: Flame Barrier
flame_barrier.scene: Kratos conjuring a wall of fire by spinning his Blades of Chaos in front of him, a roaring red-orange fire curtain shielding him, glowing embers.

rampage.name: Rampage
rampage.scene: Kratos's hand gripping the hilt of a Blade of Chaos mid-chop, blood and fire dripping from the heavy blade, a red scarred background.

exhume.name: Exhume
exhume.scene: Kratos's glowing hand reaching down into a cracked stone sarcophagus in the Underworld, a golden light spilling out of it and bony fingers grasping, stone tomb wall behind.

iron_wave.name: Iron Wave
iron_wave.scene: Kratos sweeping a Blade of Chaos outward in a sheet of crackling white-gold energy, a wave of lightning with jagged orange spears, dark maroon background.

disarm.name: Disarm
disarm.scene: Kratos wrenching a sword out of an Undead Legionnaire's grip and snapping it, a hooded blue shadow of the foe, blue magical circle behind them, one sword tip flying.

shockwave.name: Shockwave
shockwave.scene: Kratos slamming a fist into a marble floor, concentric blue-white shockwave rings rippling out in cracks, cool blue storm light.

bludgeon.name: Bludgeon
bludgeon.scene: Kratos swinging a colossal Minotaur war hammer down onto the earth, the ground splitting into glowing red cracks and flying rocks, burning red sun behind.

impervious.name: Impervious
impervious.scene: Kratos in dark silhouette with hands on hips, wrapped in a barrier of blinding golden light rays, deep blue sky behind.

uppercut.name: Uppercut
uppercut.scene: Kratos's flame-wrapped fist rising in a massive uppercut, fire and sparks trailing, red ember droplets scattering, dark maroon background.

offering.name: Offering
offering.scene: A Greek skull with red glowing eye sockets on an altar, a laurel wreath, crossed bones and stones, red candle glow, a dark crimson background.

immolate.name: Immolate
immolate.scene: A sea of orange fire rolling over hordes of Undead Legionnaires and harpies in Hades, claws and horns visible inside the flames, a red sky.

body_slam.name: Body Slam
body_slam.scene: Kratos barreling shoulder-first into a Gorgon, a huge impact explosion, light streaks of speed trailing behind him, red background.

clash.name: Clash
clash.scene: Blades of Chaos clashing against Ares's huge golden sword with a burst of sparks and golden light rays, two weapons crossed in the centre.

spot_weakness.name: Spot Weakness
spot_weakness.scene: Kratos's narrowed eye reflected in a glowing circle that targets a glowing weak point on Medusa's neck, deep blue background, gold trim.

rage.name: Rage
rage.scene: Kratos's red tattoo blazing as his hands clench into fists, red mist and red lines swirling, teeth gritted, dark crimson.

blood_for_blood.name: Blood for Blood
blood_for_blood.scene: Kratos duelling Ares in silhouette on a blood-red sky, their blades locked in a clash of sparks, drops of blood in the air.

heavy_blade.name: Heavy Blade
heavy_blade.scene: A colossal Blade of Olympus half-buried in broken black rocks, gleaming white and gold, cracks across its surface.

seeing_red.name: Seeing Red
seeing_red.scene: Kratos's face half in shadow with intense glowing red eyes, a blood-red haze and dark red background.

wild_strike.name: Wild Strike
wild_strike.scene: Kratos lunging with a wild rapid slash of his Blade of Chaos, red motion streaks and golden slash arcs across a dark crimson background.
